info.name: PAD Task 10 - local monitoring
info.description: Requires the monitoring overlay and released Task 10 Broker/owned-service images. These are loopback operational interfaces, not business Gateway routes. No service credentials or player token are needed. A metric is not a substitute for a traced business failover demonstration.

item.name: Credential and Rules report actual utilization

exec: pm.test('Both owned services have fresh load samples',()=>{const b=pm.response.json();pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('success');for(const name of ['credential-service','rules-service']){const samples=b.data.result.filter(x=>x.metric.service===name);pm.expect(samples.length,name).to.be.above(0);for(const x of samples)pm.expect(Number(x.value[1])).to.be.within(0,1);}});
